notes.title: content adjustment and bug fix
notes.content:
--- Content Adjustments ---

Adjusted item prices: lowered the prices of some items in the shop and adjusted their effects.
Slightly reduced earnings from part-time jobs.
Increased the base interaction points on weekends by 1.
Added options to disable voice, music, and sound effects.
Increased the effectiveness of certain events that boost favorability with male NPCs.
Changed the puzzle game to feature two pieces to reduce repetition.
Disabled the ability to give gifts repeatedly in the same week.
--- Bug Fixes ---

Added more resolution options.
Optimized some art assets to improve performance.
Fixed typos in certain texts.
Fixed a bug where duplicate items appeared during gift-giving.
Fixed a bug where item effects were not applied when giving gifts.
Fixed a bug where pressing Enter during shop street exploration caused repeat scenes.
Fixed a bug where hotkeys were triggered while entering a name.
Fixed some incorrect value displays.
